messages:
maria: Heads-up — Oriole private VPC deploy tonight 23:00 PT. Rolling model-serving from v2.3.1 -> v2.4 (config-only, no schema change). I'll be primary for the cutover. @kevin you own rollback, @sam you own smoke, @olivia keep an eye on traces/logs. Please ack and flag any blockers. :white_check_mark:

kevin: Ack. I'll be on-call for rollback. Quick question — is the DB migration run in a separate job or included in the deploy? I want to ensure we can revert without DB changes.

maria: No DB schema changes. There's an optional offline index job (non-blocking) scheduled after the rollout if everything looks good. Rollback path is pure service image revert.

sam: Ack. Smoke steps (I pushed to repo/oriole/deploy/smoke.sh):
```bash
# smoke.sh (quick)
curl -sS -X POST https://oriole-internal/api/v1/predict -d '{"input":"smoke test"}' | jq '.status'
# ramp to 2 qps for 60s via hey
hey -z 60s -q 2 -c 2 https://oriole-internal/api/v1/predict
```
I'll run the script once the new tasks are up and post results here.

olivia: I'll wire a temporary trace and a tail on infra logs. Will create a short alert for error_rate > 0.5% and latency p95 > 600ms. If anything trips I'll ping here and DM pager channel.

lisa: Quick CR check — infra PR #421 (vpc-peering route) is merged and in canary? If not we should gate the deploy.

maria: Confirmed — PR #421 merged and canary passed. Canary had 10% traffic for 30m with no regressions.

kevin: Rollback checklist (short):
1) Scale up previous service revision (v2.3.1) to full desired count.
2) Shift router traffic back via routing policy (run `rutil switch oriole --from v2.4 --to v2.3.1`).
3) Monitor for 10m, then scale down v2.4.
I have the script in infra/tools/rollbacks/oriole_rollback.sh and will be standing by.

maria: Timeline and handoff:
- 22:40 PT: final preflight (DB, peering, DNS check) — @olivia + @sam join for checks.
- 23:00 PT: start rollout (gradual 5-stage traffic ramp every 3m).
- ~23:20 PT: smoke + perf validation.
- 23:45 PT: optional index job if green.
If anything bad, call rollback (kevin).

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment window recorded: 2026-03-18T23:00:00-07:00 -> window_id: win-ori-20260318. Reminder ping set 30m prior.

sam: I'll post smoke output here once done. Also pinging @security-team for audit log retention check (we should keep full audit for 30d for Oriole).

olivia: Audit retention aligned — security confirmed 30d retention.

maria: Awesome. If no objections, we'll proceed with the plan. Please react with :thumbsup: when ready.

kevin: :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup:

olivia: :thumbsup:

lisa: :thumbsup:
